title: The realm has a website
body: Downloads, install steps and a help page now live in one place, so nobody has to dig through old messages to find the launcher. The status badge at the top tells you whether the realm is up before you go looking.

title: Renamed to Náströnd
body: The realm was Valhalla and is now Náströnd — the shore of corpses in Hel, which suits it better. Nothing changes on your end. If your window layout resets on the next login, do not rebuild it; ask first.
